publication issues.summary: Actual paired report records 3 unresolved render cells, 0 wire glyph differences, 0 uncertainties, 0 format questions. Compared the original scan with the V3 baseline using block-anchored and edge-anchored red/blue composites. The edge fit favors shifting columns 4–7 one character to the right, whereas the block fit favors the original positions; the edge fit has template/scale uncertainty and the block fit depends on fitted blocks. No shift was adopted. The original B10T reading was preserved. Reviewed all 92 recorded paths at sampled endpoints, bends and intermediate points, including short and zero-length records, against 31 native/composite sheets. Reviewed 27 current junctions and 85 crossing records using seven local sheets. These are sampled local observations, not continuous pixel tracing, exhaustive missing-wire detection, or electrical approval. The RESET destination branch is shifted differently under the two registrations; its existing geometry is retained. Paths crossing output text remain a representation ambiguity. Two scan-supported source-text changes were made: the RESET_IN junction at (45,68) is a diamond, not a crossing; and the space before the RESET MARKS caption at (210,37) is blank. The first adds the existing-net junction to the V3 record; the second changes only its displayed glyph, retaining the source route and connectivity. Nodes, nets, wire paths, printed labels and crossing claims remain unchanged. Final V3 and V4/review/TXT are in Final V3 and Final V4 v2. The converter reported three differing cells at the damaged header: source has CT followed by three replacement characters, while the rendered page identity is CT021. Those discrepancies are retained unresolved. The V4 remains partial/unapproved; no format questions. V3 normalization, restoration and text round trip, V4 internal validation, sidecar digest and preservation of B10T passed. Full external JSON-schema validation was not run. No whole-page wiring/source approval or production publication fo Current selected json and txt differs from candidate review source; historical mismatch retained. The candidate source does not fully match the previous local selection: model match False, text match False. The previous selection is preserved in the publication receipt.
